mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, a.* FROM ( SELECT E.*, DECODE(REQUEST_STATUS, 'Request', '승인요청', 'Approved', '승인완료', 'Rejected', '승인거절', REQUEST_STATUS) AS statusName FROM EVO_SELLER_REQUEST E ORDER BY request_date DESC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= #{end} ) WHERE rn >= #{start}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, a.* FROM ( SELECT E.*, CASE WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'Request' THEN '승인요청' WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'Approved' THEN '승인완료' WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'Rejected' THEN '승인거절' ELSE REQUEST_STATUS END AS statusName FROM EVO_SELLER_REQUEST E WHERE REQUEST_STATUS = #{status} ORDER BY request_date DESC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= #{end} ) WHERE rn >= #{start}
mapper.update: UPDATE EVO_SELLER_REQUEST SET REQUEST_STATUS = 'Approved', PROCESSED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SELLER_REQ_NO = #{sellerReqNo} AND REQUEST_STATUS = 'Request'
